messages.subject: Milkweed for PNW
messages.text:
What kind will grow in Seattle area? Thank you 

Jennifer 

Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: Re: Milkweed for PNW
messages.text:
Hello Jennifer,
 

 For the Seattle area (western Washington), these milkweed species are the best fits:
 Showy milkweed (Asclepias speciosa) , the most common native milkweed in the region, full sun, adaptable.

 Narrowleaf milkweed (Asclepias fascicularis) , likes sunny, well-drained spots; often does best in warmer microclimates

We have these species here: https://lasclay.com/en-us/collections/garden

 

 Chaleureusement,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-fondateur 
 Lasclay

messages.subject: Re: Milkweed for PNW
messages.text:
Hi Jennifer,

So sorry for leaving you hanging on this for so long, it's embarrassing on our end.

The "Western Canada only" restriction you saw was a shipping limitation on that specific listing. Our US store should have the right options for you. Try here: https://lasclay.com/en-us/collections/garden

Showy milkweed (Asclepias speciosa) and Narrowleaf (Asclepias fascicularis) are both available for US shipping and are your best bets for the Seattle area.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
